# Skill 4 — Collection & Payment Reminder

A Claude Code **skill**. Watches every open and partial invoice, buckets it by days-past-due, and drafts tone-appropriate reminder messages. Designed to run daily.

## Layout

```
skills/collection-reminder/
├── SKILL.md                      # skill — frontmatter + instructions Claude reads
├── scripts/
│   └── collection_reminder.py    # bucketing engine + CLI
├── install.sh                    # copies skill into .claude/skills/ to activate
└── README.qmd                    # this file
```

## Activate it

```bash
bash skills/collection-reminder/install.sh
```

Restart Claude Code (or open a new session) to activate.

## Using it through Claude

> "Run today's collection reminders."
> "Who owes us money?"
> "Show all critical invoices."
> "Draft a reminder for invoice INV00042."
> "How much is outstanding from CUST0013?"

## Running the script directly

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate

# Daily report (all buckets)
uv run python skills/collection-reminder/scripts/collection_reminder.py

# Only critical invoices (60+ days past due)
uv run python skills/collection-reminder/scripts/collection_reminder.py --bucket critical

# All invoices for one customer
uv run python skills/collection-reminder/scripts/collection_reminder.py --customer CUST0013

# Single invoice drill-down
uv run python skills/collection-reminder/scripts/collection_reminder.py --invoice INV00042

# Draft LLM reminders for top 3 most urgent
uv run python skills/collection-reminder/scripts/collection_reminder.py --model api-llama-4-scout

# JSON output
uv run python skills/collection-reminder/scripts/collection_reminder.py --json
```

## Bucket definitions

| Bucket | Days past due | Tone |
|---|---|---|
| Upcoming | −5 to 0 | Friendly heads-up |
| Just Due | 1–7 | Polite nudge |
| Aging | 8–30 | Firm reminder |
| Overdue | 31–60 | Escalation |
| Critical | 60+ | Urgent — flag for management |

Invoices more than 5 days before due are silently excluded (too early to remind).

## Tests

```bash
uv run pytest tests/skills/test_collection_reminder.py -v
```

22 tests covering `classify_invoice`, `bucket_invoices`, `daily_report`, `header_line`, `format_table`, and CLI.
